metadata.title: Decoding Contextual Factors Differentiating Adolescents’ High, Average, and Low Digital Reading Performance Through Machine-Learning Methods

design_fields.q1_rationale: The study used a single plausible value (PV1READ) for analysis, which does not meet the criteria for proper handling of plausible values.
design_fields.q2_rationale: The study uses ILSA student-level data but does not mention whether sampling weights were applied.
design_fields.q3_rationale: The study appears to model individual students without accounting for school clustering, as there is no mention of multilevel modeling or cluster-robust standard errors.
design_fields.q4_rationale: The study mentions model evaluation but does not indicate any validation on external datasets or different countries, only internal validation methods.
